splits-same-group-by-instance.alertmanager.yml:
route:
  receiver: fallback
  group_by:
  - alertname
  - cluster
  - instance
  group_wait: 400ms
  group_interval: 200ms
  repeat_interval: 1s
  routes:
  - receiver: urgent
    matchers:
    - severity="critical"
  - receiver: standard
    matchers:
    - severity="warning"
receivers:
- name: urgent
  webhook_configs:
  - url: http://127.0.0.1:0/urgent
    send_resolved: true
- name: standard
  webhook_configs:
  - url: http://127.0.0.1:0/standard
    send_resolved: true
- name: fallback
  webhook_configs:
  - url: http://127.0.0.1:0/fallback
    send_resolved: true
